# Trailquest / 트레일퀘스트

> A free, ad-free virtual long-trail tracker with no account. Type in the
> distance you really walked or ran (or paste your phone's step count) and
> your marker moves along the Pacific Crest Trail, the Appalachian Trail, the
> Continental Divide Trail, the Camino de Santiago, the John Muir Trail, the
> Baekdudaegan ridge or a Tokyo-to-Kyoto Tōkaidō, unlocking milestones as you
> pass them. Custom routes with your own milestones are free too.

This is a Progressive Web App (PWA) hosted at https://trailquest.try-dabble.com/
Routes, log entries, milestones and preferences stay in this browser on this
device. No accounts, no membership, no uploads, no server storage, no ads, no
in-app purchases, no automatic step or GPS tracking, and no generative AI
landscapes: every picture is hand-drawn SVG. Export a JSON backup to survive
a reinstall or a new phone.

This is NOT a fitness tracker that reads HealthKit or Google Fit (a web app
cannot), NOT a GPS recorder and NOT a social leaderboard. Every entry is one
you typed in on purpose.

## Features

- Seven preset routes with ordered, named milestones in Korean, English, Japanese and Chinese
- Custom routes: name, total distance in miles or km, optional milestones
- Manual distance log: distance, date, optional note; mi / km toggle
- Step-count helper: paste steps, set steps per mile, log the converted distance
- Progress per route: percentage, walked, remaining, next milestone, SVG trail map
- Milestones unlock with the date they were reached; lock again if an entry is removed
- Edit or delete any entry; progress recalculates on the spot
- Switching routes keeps every route's own progress and log
- Stats: total distance, active days, current streak, longest streak
- JSON export / import of routes, entries, progress and preferences
- Text size A / A+ / A++
- Installable PWA with a network-first service worker
